text:
Sam R.: Hey team — noticed a PTO payout in my 03/15 paycheck got processed as taxable wages. Should've been an expense reimbursement per the approved exception. Net hit ~ $480. Can someone check?
Alex (People Ops): Thanks @Sam R. — can you DM the paystub screenshot and confirm pay period + employee ID so payroll can look it up?
Sam R.: Sending now. Pay period 03/01-03/15. EmpID 47291. Last 4 SSN 1234. Screenshot attached in DM.
PayrollBot: Note: Payroll run for 03/15 has closed. Changes will roll in next cycle unless a manual adjustment is requested.
Jamie K. (Payroll): Hi Sam — quick q: do you want a net reimbursement (non-taxable) issued and a reversing payroll entry to remove the taxable wage, or do you want a gross reclassification so YTD taxes are corrected? Both possible but have different steps.
Sam R.: Prefer net reimbursement + correct YTD tax treatment if possible. Bank last4 for ACH: 6789.
Maria L.: Just to clarify policy: PTO buyouts are normally taxable when paid as payroll, but when approved as an expense reimbursement (rare exception) they can be non-taxable. Looks like this was mis-coded. We'll treat this as an exception this cycle.
Jamie K. (Payroll): Thanks. I'll open a manual adjustment ticket. Plan: (1) Issue non-taxable reimbursement for net amount via ACH next business day, (2) create reversing payroll entry in next payroll to remove the taxable wage, (3) coordinate with Tax for any required amendments to filings/W-2. ETA ~5 business days. Assigning to PR-5921.
Alex (People Ops): Sounds good. @Jamie K. please include the tax-team if reversal requires amended forms. I'll keep Sam updated.
Jamie K. (Payroll): Created ticket PR-5921 and scheduled manual payment. Internal link: https://payroll.internal/tickets/PR-5921. Payroll journal (summary):
```
Original (03/15):
  GL 5000 Wages: $600.00
  Federal Tax Withheld: $120.00
  State Tax Withheld: $30.00

Adjustment (manual):
  Reverse wage: -$600.00 to GL 5000
  Issue reimbursement: $480.00 to GL 6100 (non-taxable)
  Reverse tax withholdings: -$150.00 (pending tax-team review)
```
PayrollBot: Manual adjustment scheduled for 2026-04-01 payroll cycle. Note: tax-team will confirm whether amended returns or W-2 correction required.
Sam R.: Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast turnaround :pray:
Alex (People Ops): :thumbsup: We'll post updates here when the payment goes out or if tax-team requests anything else.
